name: contact.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  contact.scss — the home page's contact footer: a full-bleed dark band
//  (--bg-dark) containing heading, email/social links and CTA copy inside a
//  %MAXAREA column. The nav's --on-dark variant keys off this section.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import '../../base/variables';
@import '../../base/mixins';
@import '../../base/fonts';
@import '../../base/placeholders';
@import '../../base/structure';

// Shadow host.
:host {
  display: block;
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
}

// The dark contact band: full-bleed --bg-dark with the contact content in a %MAXAREA column.
.contact {
  @extend %MAXAREA;
  @extend %SKEL_DARK_SURFACE;

  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: 100%;
  padding-top: to-rem($space-3xl);
  padding-bottom: to-rem($space-3xl);
  background-color: var(--bg-dark);
  color: var(--color-white-raw);
  border-top: to-rem($space-hairline) solid transparent;
  border-image: var(--metallic-hairline) 1;
  background-image: var(--filament-glow);
  display: block;
  text-align: center;
  max-width: 100%;

  @include layout-768() {
    padding-top: to-rem($space-4xl);
    padding-bottom: to-rem($space-3xl);
  }

  &-title {
    @extend .ttl-lg;

    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: inherit;
    margin: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: 100%;
    text-align: center;
    padding: to-rem($space-2xl) 0 to-rem($space-xl);

    @include layout-768() {
      padding: to-rem($space-3xl) 0 to-rem($space-2xl);
    }
  }

  &-social,
  &-other {
    @extend .ttl-xs;

    color: inherit;

    &-link {
      transition: opacity 0.3s ease-in;
      color: inherit;
      text-decoration: none;

      &:hover,
      &:focus {
        opacity: 0.5;
      }
    }

    // '·' between links — hidden on mobile where the links stack vertically
    // (a separator would hang on its own line); appears ≥768px inline row.
    &-separator {
      padding: 0 to-rem($space-md);
      display: none;
      font-weight: 700;

      @include layout-768() {
        display: inline-block;
      }

      @include layout-2560() {
        padding: 0 to-rem($space-lg);
      }
    }
  }

  &-social {
    width: 100%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    padding: 0 0 to-rem($space-2xl);

    @include layout-768() {
      padding: 0 0 to-rem($space-lg);
    }

    &-link {
      @extend .ttl-sm;

      display: block;
      line-height: to-rem($space-3xl);
      cursor: pointer;

      @include layout-768() {
        display: inline-block;
      }
    }
  }

  &-other {
    padding: to-rem($space-2xl) to-rem($space-lg) 0;

    @include layout-768() {
      padding: to-rem($space-lg) to-rem($space-4xl) 0;
    }

    &-link {
      @extend .ttl-xs;

      display: block;
      line-height: to-rem($space-3xl);
      font-weight: 700;
      position: relative;

      @include layout-768() {
        display: inline-block;
      }

      &.router-link-active {
        text-decoration: underline;
        cursor: pointer;
      }
    }
  }
}
